author: Cyberpunk1210
title: GPU unit tests fail with a burst of 36 gtest-parallel worker crashes among the first ~37 scheduled tests
signature: GPU unit tests accuracy tolerance mismatch in fusion test (val_ref vs val_opt difference exceeds tolerance in fusion_test_common.hpp) followed by burst of concurrent gtest-parallel worker processes exiting with code 3|Flaky Test

failed_jobs.name: GPU unit tests
failed_jobs.symptom: ov_gpu_unit_tests.exe run via gtest_parallel.py reported 36/29333 failures: all 36 are scattered gtest-parallel worker processes that exited with raw exit code 3 (process crash, no gtest PASSED/FAILED output captured) among the first ~46 scheduled test slots; no genuine gtest assertion failure was present in this run.

root_cause: This is the 13th recorded occurrence of the previously-tracked recurring pattern (signature_hash 502c01bffd8f35db). The GPU unit test binary (ov_gpu_unit_tests.exe) is launched under gtest_parallel.py, which fans out ~29333 test cases across many concurrent worker processes immediately at job start. In this run, all 36 failing tests (spread across the first ~46 scheduled test slots, e.g. slots 7-46) terminated with raw exit code 3 (no gtest PASSED/FAILED banner, no assertion message captured) rather than completing normally - the classic signature of workers crashing due to resource contention (GPU device/driver contention, OpenCL context exhaustion, or memory pressure) when gtest-parallel spins up too many concurrent ov_gpu_unit_tests.exe instances at start-up on the Windows GPU runner (ov-dmz-59, runner group 'intel-gpu'). This failure is not attributable to the triggering commit/PR #39057 ('[GPU] Support u2 compressed dictionaries in GatherCompressed'), which only adds a u2 decode branch to GatherCompressed/gather_ref and does not touch convolution, fusion, or the gtest-parallel harness; none of the 36 crashed tests are gather tests. The recurring crash burst has now been observed across 12 prior, unrelated commits spanning more than 5 days with no fix landed.
reproduction_steps: N/A - intermittent, environment/concurrency dependent. Best-effort local repro: on a Windows GPU runner, build the gpu-unit-tests target and run `python gtest_parallel.py --dump_json_test_results=TEST-gpu-unit.json ov_gpu_unit_tests.exe` with the same high worker concurrency as CI while the GPU is also under load from another process, to try to trigger early worker crashes.
recommended_actions: Investigate whether gtest-parallel's initial worker fan-out count exceeds the GPU runner's safe concurrent-OpenCL-context limit; consider throttling --workers or adding a ramp-up delay for the GPU unit test job specifically.

Capture and review Windows Event Viewer / driver logs for the affected runner (ov-dmz-59) around the failure window (01:05:59-01:06:10Z) to confirm whether exit code 3 corresponds to a GPU driver TDR (timeout detection and recovery) or OOM kill rather than a test assertion.

Given this is the 13th occurrence of signature 502c01bffd8f35db spanning over 5 days with no fix landed, escalate to the GPU plugin CI/infra owners to triage the worker-crash root cause directly on the runner rather than continuing to treat each occurrence as a one-off flaky rerun.

Add retry-with-backoff or automatic re-run of only the tests that returned exit code 3 (as opposed to tests with real gtest FAILED assertions) in the gtest-parallel GPU unit test invocation to distinguish infra crashes from genuine regressions in reporting.
prevention_strategies: Add retry-with-backoff or automatic re-run of only the tests that returned exit code 3 in the gtest-parallel GPU unit test invocation, since exit-code-3 crashes without gtest output are a distinct, likely-infrastructure failure mode from genuine assertion failures. Track recurring 'Flaky Test' signatures like this one with an escalation threshold (e.g., auto-file or bump priority on a tracking issue once count crosses 5, now at 13) so transient-looking patterns that are in fact a persistent environment issue get prioritized fixes instead of indefinite accumulation in this database.
historical_context: This is the 13th recorded occurrence of signature 502c01bffd8f35db ('GPU unit tests fail with a burst of ~36 gtest-parallel worker crashes among the first ~37-46 scheduled tests'), first seen 2026-11-13T17:54:36Z and recurring across 12 prior unrelated commits/PRs with no fix yet landed (most recently PR #39954 by akladiev on 2026-11-18T01:25:58Z). The commit for this run (bfbb23500507535827fa817e0cd069b0bc7b664d, PR #39057 by Cyberpunk1210) only extends GatherCompressed with a u2 decode path on the GPU and is unrelated to the failure. Separate Infrastructure signatures for the same job (3be0e72d6ae29098 PowerShell execution-policy error, 514ffa2ab52ad344 locked tbb12.dll, a9c74b1ea2c2e7f5 80-minute timeout) have also recurred on this same Windows GPU unit tests job in the past, indicating this specific CI lane is a recurring source of flaky/infra noise independent of code changes.
